Metrics.Name: graph2otel.build_info
Metrics.Description: Constant 1 build-info gauge; carries the graph2otel version and Go runtime version as attributes.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.checkpoint.persist.errors
Metrics.Description: Count of failed checkpoint high-water-mark persists, per collector.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.ingest.source_records
Metrics.Description: Count of logical source records fetched by completed collector runs, classified by traffic phase.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.payload.type_mismatches
Metrics.Description: Count of payload fields whose JSON type differed from the expected type.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.record.outcomes
Metrics.Description: Count of source records by processing outcome.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.budget
Metrics.Description: Last scrape's duration as a fraction of the collector's poll interval.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.duration
Metrics.Description: Wall-clock duration of the last scrape, per collector.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.errors
Metrics.Description: Count of failed scrapes, per collector, classified by error.type.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.last_timestamp
Metrics.Description: Unix time, in seconds, at which the most recent scrape finished.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.outcomes
Metrics.Description: Count of collector runs by reconciled record outcome.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.staleness
Metrics.Description: Seconds elapsed since this collector's last successful scrape.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.scrape.success
Metrics.Description: 1 if the last scrape result was empty or success; 0 for partial or failure.
